audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty text was accurate in shape (even, 47.62% WR over 168 games) but timings were vague — 'sweetspots knock up, sidestep them' with no cooldown to key off.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade is 14s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 5, so the punish window collapses as he levels. That is the whole reason 3-5 is his phase.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added to dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[1].text so the advice is keyed to a real gap.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] described 'three Q angles plus W chain-pull' without saying what actually changes at that level.
audit.why: His spike is the Q cooldown falling to 8s by rank 4 plus Infernal Chains guaranteeing the re-engage — that is what makes 3-5 unwinnable in a long trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names the 8s Q and the drag-back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields attributed Aatrox's pull to Umbral Dash (E). Umbral Dash is a directional dash with heal-on-damage; the pull-to-centre is Infernal Chains (W).
audit.why: Wrong ability name means the player watches the wrong cooldown — E is 9s at rank 1, W is 20s. The decisive interaction is also unstated: Twisted Advance is untargetable during the dash, so it eats a Q swing outright, and Umbral Dash is his only out from the root.
audit.corrected: whys[2], mid and wants.foe[1] now say Infernal Chains; report[5].t and phases[1].why state the untargetable-dash interaction and E's 9s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed no numbers at all.
audit.why: Q 14s->6s, Umbral Dash 9s, Nature's Grasp 130s at rank 1 are the three timers this lane runs on.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side said 'Skill' while win[4] said 'Maokai' — the two layers rendered different answers for Level 6.
audit.why: whys[4], spikes[2] and the packet levelChart all put Level 6 with Maokai.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side flipped to Maokai to match win[4]; content layer already correct so no paired content edit is needed.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Aatrox's The Darkin Blade is down.
edits.after: Twisted Advance is untargetable mid-dash, so it eats a Q swing outright — land it on his windup, then Q knocks him off the follow-up.

edits.before: Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Q3's sweetspot knocks up. It is 14s at rank 1 — engage in that gap, not before.

edits.before: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: matchup-defining — Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1 but 6s at rank 5 — the punish gap shrinks every point he puts in it. - Umbral Dash: 9s, his only out from your root. - Nature's Grasp: 130s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Aatrox's The Darkin Blade: Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep them. When it is down — W-Q + R him.
edits.after: Umbral Dash (9s) is his only out from Twisted Advance, and your W is untargetable mid-dash — it eats his Q.

edits.before: Aatrox's peak — three Q angles plus W chain-pull and passive heal-on-hit out-grind your trades in the extended duel.
edits.after: Aatrox's peak — his Q drops to 8s by rank 4 and Infernal Chains drags you back, so long trades ride his heal-on-hit.

edits.before: His three Q angles, Umbral Dash pull, and heal-on-hit passive out-grind you in the extended trade he is built for.
edits.after: His three Q angles, Infernal Chains drag, and heal-on-hit passive out-grind you in the extended trade he is built for.

edits.before: Chain W (Umbral Dash pull) into Q and ride passive heal-on-hit through your poke
edits.after: Chain W (Infernal Chains) into Q and ride passive heal-on-hit through your poke

edits.before: Levels 3-5 are his — stacked Q sweetspots, the Umbral Dash pull, and passive heal-on-hit mean every long trade tilts his way, so use E (Sapling Toss) to zone the wave and hold position rather than dueling. At 6 your R (Nature's Grasp) is the equalizer: don't open with it, hold it to root him the instant he commits his combat-stat all-in, then walk out of the bramble window while his R reset is wasted. Sap Magic plus a sapling for vision keeps you from getting collapsed when his jungler shows.

notes: Per the mirror audit, Aatrox's Infernal Chains carries a derived 'grounding' flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only) — no grounding claim made here either. Spell-shield/QSS/tenacity eligibility for Twisted Advance is not in the kit data, so nothing was asserted about it.
